events.title: 폴 스콜스 scores twice as a 3–1 win over 뉴캐슬 유나이티드 extend 맨체스터 유나이티드's winning run to six games.
MLS contracts league down to ten clubs by eliminating its two Florida franchises: Tampa Bay Mutiny and Miami Fusion .
A 3–1 win at 사우샘프턴 takes 맨체스터 유나이티드 top of the Premier League on goal difference after seven successive wins lifted them from ninth place.
Colin Todd is sacked after three months as 더비 카운티 manager.
맨체스터 유나이티드 extend their winning run to eight league games with a 2–1 home win over 블랙번 로버스.
맨체스터 유나이티드 boost their attack with a £7.5 million move for Uruguayan striker Diego Forlán from 인데펜디엔테 of Argentina .
John Gregory resigns after four years as manager of 애스턴 빌라 .
John Gregory returns to management six days after leaving 애스턴 빌라 when he is named as the new manager of 더비 카운티 .

January ends with top place in the Premier League going to 맨체스터 유나이티드, who were ninth in the table less than two months ago. In second place are 아스널, who are four points behind with two games in hand. Bracketed together, one point behind 아스널, are 리버풀 and 뉴캐슬 유나이티드. 리즈 유나이티드 complete the top five. A terrible month for 레스터 시티 has left them bottom of the table and eight points adrift of safety, with 더비 카운티 just one places and two points above them. 입스위치 타운 remain in the drop zone despite a recent run of good results, while a mere three points separate the next seven clubs – 볼턴 원더러스, 블랙번 로버스, 사우샘프턴, 미들즈브러, 에버턴, 웨스트햄 유나이티드 and 선덜랜드. The race to get into the Premier League is now led by 맨체스터 시티, who are six points ahead of their nearest rivals 울버햄프턴 원더러스 at the top of Division One. 웨스트브로미치 앨비언, 밀월, 번리 and 크리스털 팰리스 complete the top six.
